local_verification.visual_review: Actual desktop and phone screenshots inspected

preservation: All previous Goober files retained. Main app.js, stylesheet, service worker, enrichment script, catalog and original artwork bytes unchanged. Existing context-card page and gallery action link extended. The fetched existing SaeDow module was compiled without semantic store changes: same IndexedDB database, record schema and checked append. No second task queue, state database or identity layer.
scope: Explicit user form submission keeps a title, note, why, optional next step, selected public picture link and fingerprint in the existing browser-local field log. All21 public catalog pictures can enter the same action. Opening links never saves. Unknown references, other project selectors, corrupt logs and failed writes do not become completed saves. Exact sequential repeats reuse a matching entry.
naming: $aveBambi has this bounded local UI implementation. It is not a globally installed command or autonomous care/worker service. Nephew/nephwe remains generic relationship/project vocabulary, not a game name.
limits: No host, DNS, tunnel or account effects
No worker dispatch or live Skein acceptance
